title: Juicy Mediterranean Prawn Ceviche
description: A refreshing and light Mediterranean dish featuring raw tiger prawns, perfect for a lazy Sunday, with a sour and aerated twist from the shio cure and citrus juices.
instructions: Rinse the prawns under cold water and pat them dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together the shio cure, lemon juice, and lime juice.
Add the garlic, red onion, and parsley to the bowl and stir to combine.
Add the prawns to the bowl and toss to coat with the shio cure mixture.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the prawns to cure.
After 30 minutes, remove the bowl from the refrigerator and stir in the olive oil.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Cover the bowl again and refrigerate for an additional 10 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve the ceviche chilled, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
